headline: Bravqulin explains the basis of its scrap disposal ledger
summary: Bravqulin Textiles disposed of 640 tonnes of scrap during January through March. Its ledger also lists gross receipts of 640 thousand USD, before transport deductions. The monetary amount applies to each individual month, not the three months combined.
